_README: Single source of truth for CV content. cv.html (the designed master), cv-ats.html (the ATS export) and the CV tailor all draw from here. The Cloudflare Worker verifies every bullet it emits against the strings in this file, so nothing reaches a page that isn't approved here. Add a variant here before the tailor can ever use it.

positioning.thesis: My expertise is behavioural and market analysis grounded in statistical method. Give me any sector and I'll learn it fast and make it legible — I've already done it across five unrelated domains.
positioning.capabilityTagline: I answer "why do people do this?" with statistical rigour — across markets, products, and organisations — and turn the answer into something a room can act on.
positioning.methodsLine: Behavioural investigation — designing research and experiments to explain why people, users, and markets behave as they do, and translating findings into decisions.

summaries.master: Analytics strategist and behavioural researcher with 6+ years building data infrastructure, governance, and insight functions for global organisations — most recently owning BI delivery for a newly created talent intelligence function at Publicis Groupe. Proven track record standardising practices across large divisions and translating complex data into strategic insight for audiences ranging from C-suite to entry-level staff. Academically specialised in behavioural economics (MSc) and marketing (BSc). Hands-on with SQL (T-SQL), Python, R, Snowflake, Nielsen, Mintel and Kantar. Targeting analytics leadership, behavioural insight, or research roles where human-centred data shapes product or policy decisions.

dissertation.title: MSc Dissertation — Social Capital & Life Satisfaction
dissertation.institution: City St George's, University of London
bullets: Graded 71%, a distinction-band mark, supervised by Dr Anke Plagnol.
Drivers of life satisfaction across five countries using International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) 2017 data (n = 11,249), analysed in R.

Methods: multiple imputation (MICE, predictive mean matching, grouped by country), PCA-built multi-item constructs, country-level and pooled OLS with interaction terms, Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons (LSmeans), and VIF and AIC/BIC model checks.
Trust in fairness was the only universal cross-cultural predictor of life satisfaction; income was non-significant, though subjective financial strain was not.

project.title: Wimbledon Men's Draw, Monte Carlo Match Simulator — Independent Project
bullets: A head-to-head prediction engine that plays a match out one point at a time, built on IBM Slam Tracker data — roughly 48,000 points a season across 2011–2023.

Every player carries a profile page built only from their own record: serve, return and under-pressure characteristics — how unpredictably they serve, how they hold at break point, how they fade across sets — weighted by recency and opponent quality.
Two profiles are then run against each other thousands of times. Backtested on 908 matches, each season predicted from prior seasons only.
